candidates.summary: only the AppState==nil gate keeps the reset off a pre-#1941 committed data dir, and no test pins it
candidates.failure_scenario: A data dir that applied its genesis before gnolang/gno#1941 has no height-0 ABCI responses key, and its doc was persisted before gnolang/gno#5684, so the doc still carries AppState. The ADR's Consequences bullet says such a dir never reaches resetToGenesisDoc, and the only thing that makes that true is `} else if genDoc.AppState == nil {`. Every new test seeds its doc through saveGenesisDoc, which strips AppState, so none of them covers a persisted doc that carries one. Widen the line to `} else {` and they all stay green. The node would then rebuild the state record of a chain at height N from the genesis file, then panic in ReplayBlocks with StoreBlockHeight (N) > StateBlockHeight + 1, with the state record already overwritten.
candidates.verify_by: grep -n genesisDocKey tm2/pkg/bft/node/*_test.go shows only key comparisons (node_test.go:674, :711) and no raw write of a doc carrying AppState. Mutate node.go:1092 to `} else {` and run `go test ./tm2/pkg/bft/node -run 'LoadStateFromDBOrGenesisDocProvider|E2E|GenesisReset|SaveGenesisDoc'`: expect red, observe green. The missing test writes amino.MarshalJSON of a doc with types.MockAppState under genesisDocKey, saves a state record at LastBlockHeight 500 with no height-0 key, boots with a changed InitialHeight, and asserts LastBlockHeight stays 500.
candidates.evidence: grep genesisDocKey in tm2 tests: node_test.go:674 and :711 only, both `bytes.Equal(key, genesisDocKey)` inside injected-error DB wrappers; every seeded doc goes through saveGenesisDoc, which sets stripped.AppState = nil

candidates.summary: a doc a pre-PR binary persisted without validation (empty chain id) is never healed: the reset sits behind the chain id equality check
candidates.failure_scenario: A pre-PR binary boots a genesis.json with an empty chain_id. Its saveGenesisDoc persists the doc before MakeGenesisState rejects it, so ChainID is "" and the height-0 key is absent. The operator upgrades to this branch and fixes chain_id to "x". loadGenesisDoc then returns ChainID "", the check at node.go:1101 fails with `genesis chain id mismatch between persisted state ("") and source genesis ("x"): the genesis file backing this data dir has changed`, and the node never reaches genesisApplied or resetToGenesisDoc. The data dir stays unbootable until it is wiped. Validate-before-save only governs writes the new binary makes, and the ADR lists the height-0-key case from older binaries but not this one. Recovery is a wipe of a data dir that never applied a genesis.
candidates.verify_by: Seed a memdb with saveGenesisDoc of a doc whose ChainID is "" (the pre-PR first-boot write order), then call LoadStateFromDBOrGenesisDocProvider with probeGenesisDocProvider(pk, 1): expect the boot to succeed or name the invalid persisted doc, observe the 'genesis chain id mismatch ... ("") ... ("genesis-doc-test")' error
candidates.evidence: node.go:1101 `if freshDoc.ChainID != genDoc.ChainID {` precedes genesisApplied (1114) and resetToGenesisDoc (1119); base first-boot order was saveGenesisDoc then sm.LoadStateFromDBOrGenesisDoc -> MakeGenesisState -> ValidateAndComplete (state.go:213)

candidates.summary: the reset replaces the persisted genesis doc and state record silently, with no log line or signal to NewNode
candidates.failure_scenario: A boot fails before InitChain succeeds, either refused or for a local reason such as the event store or proxy app. If genesis.json then changes (same chain id and app hash, but different validators, genesis_time or initial_height) before the restart, resetToGenesisDoc adopts the file's doc and rebuilds the state record. LoadStateFromDBOrGenesisDocProvider has no logger and returns nothing that says a reset happened, so the operator's log shows a normal boot with no trace that the doc the data dir held was replaced.
candidates.verify_by: Read node.go:1114-1120 and resetToGenesisDoc (1146-1157): no logger call and no return value distinguishes a reset from a normal load; NewNode (node.go:415) logs nothing about it either
candidates.evidence: LoadStateFromDBOrGenesisDocProvider(stateDB, genesisDocProvider) takes no logger; resetToGenesisDoc returns (state, genDoc, nil) like the normal path
